label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_01
text: Hmm. Here should be good.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_02
text: Y’know, I was thinking about the look you get\nwhen you’re in battle...[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_03
text: and I realized I’ve only ever seen you like that\nfrom the sidelines.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_04
text: Guess now I know what it’s like to face you\nfrom across the court![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_05
text: Lemme be real—I’m counting on you to conquer\nthe whole BB League, bud.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_06
text: I mean it. I need you to pull this off! You gotta\ncome through for me![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_07
text: That said...[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_08
text: I’m not just gonna roll over and miss out on the\nfun. So watch out.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_09
text: But no need for us to get all official or anything![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_10
text: Just battle me normally like you would anybody\nelse, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_11
text: Here’s the 100-percent Drayster truth: I’m so\npsyched I’m practically tingling.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_12
text: So why don’t we get this rolling, nice and easy?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_13
text: Let’s go, bud. Show me a good time![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_14
text: Heh heh heh! Man, that was ridiculous. So\nmuch fun.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_15
text: I knew inviting you to join the League Club was\nthe right move![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_16
text: And I guess if you can beat me, we better make\nyou a full member, finally! Whaddya say? Ready\r\nto be the real deal?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_17
text: Heh heh! Bless you and your generous heart![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_18
text: Aw, no need to play hard to get! I know I saw the\nspark of enthusiasm in your eye...[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_19
text: C’mon, let’s get a photo of you for the club\nroster![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_20
text: Lacey probably woulda wanted a more serious\nphoto. She might not be thrilled, but oh well.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_21
text: I feel like there was one more thing I’m supposed\nto do...[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_22
text: Oh, yeah. We gotta give TMs to whoever can\nbeat us Elite Four members.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_23
text: I gotta go grab that. Wait here a sec.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_clerk_npc
text: Congratulations on besting Drayton of the Elite\nFour!
